scope: Canada-wide discovery centred on official CSA and NRC technology-development records and company technical sources for space platforms, PNT, satellite communications, sensing, photonics, mission software and enabling materials. The run also searched DND public-needs pages, procurement partner notices, bilingual government sources, official company newsrooms and the live production corpus.
